ghi_chu: Bang khai gia tri KHONG DUOC DICH tren muoi man con lai cua Cai dat. Chan `man-that.mjs khong-dich` sinh tap ung vien TU MAN THAT (moi phan tu mang translate="no", hop voi moi chuoi hien giong het nhau o hai luot locale) tren MOI route cua lat, roi doi chieu CA HAI CHIEU voi bang nay. Ba luat co ten duoi day tru truoc nhung gia tri may tu suy duoc tu may chu — so, du lieu nguoi nhap, vat khach chep — de bang khong phinh theo du lieu cua tung may.

luat.vi_sao: Chuoi chi gom chu so va dau cau khong mang tu nao de dich: so dong cua bang, dau ngoac quanh so, gach ngang thay cho o trong.

Ten cong ty, dia chi website, slug, ten va email tung thanh vien, chu cai dau tren anh dai dien, ten mien duoc phep. Nguoi go vao, doi theo tung may, nen khong dong thanh bang duoc — AC-6b do chung bang luat translate="no".

Manh cua the script theo doi: scriptUrl, siteId va cac manh dau the. Chung lay tu tRPC tracking.settings — nguon that ngoai man — chu khong phai chu cua man. Luat chi an khi manh do nam trong phan tu mang translate="no".

dong.vi_sao: Dinh danh ky thuat tren thanh ben. Luat kho cam duc tu ghep tieng Viet cho thuat ngu ky thuat.
Kho chuoi khai cung mot chu o ca hai ban: nhan nay la dinh danh nguoi dung phai doc lai nguyen van khi doi chieu voi he thong khac.
Tien to giao thuc dat truoc o nhap dia chi. Khong phai chu nguoi doc.
Dia chi mau trong o goi y cua buoc kiem tra cai dat. Giu nguyen o ca hai ban.

ngoai_lat.ghi_chu: Chuoi tieng Anh hien tren man cua lat nhung NGUON nam ngoai lat va ngoai pham vi vong. Khai co ten de chan do khong do oan; chung van la GIOI HAN da khai, khong phai da dich.

khoi.vi_sao: packages/auth la t3_paths — keo vao la doi hang vong va them mot cong duyet ke hoach; khai ngoai pham vi tu Cong 1

mien_dau.vi_sao: ban dich dung cua 'Cookies' — tu muon, tieng Viet khong them dau cho no. Ve dau cua AC-1 la phep do gan dung; day la cho no bao oan.
